ko.executive_summary: 삼성은 내부 테스트에서 Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6의 심각한 성능 문제를 발견했으며, 삼성은 Galaxy S27 Ultra에 Exynos 사용 계획을 메모리 가격 급등으로 취소했다. NVIDIA RTX Spark PC와 MediaTek 칩셋이 출시되며 AI 에이전트 시장이 확대되고 있다.
key_facts: Samsung internal tests found severe performance issues in Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6
Samsung cancels Exynos plan for Galaxy S27 Ultra due to memory price surge
NVIDIA RTX Spark PCs launched with MediaTek chip
Samsung hosts Silicon Valley Future Wireless Summit 2026

implications.text: Performance issues may force Samsung toward alternative SoC suppliers or accelerate internal Exynos development for premium flagships
Continuing problems could erode Qualcomm's dominant position in Android flagship processors
DRAM/NAND price increases are pushing OEMs to reconsider chip sourcing economics and vertical integration strategies

ko.counterpoint: Qualcomm's leadership position remains entrenched despite near-term issues; Samsung's internal chip options remain constrained at premium performance tiers.
